title: Data Scientist (EEG, contract)
employment: Contract, about 20 hours a week. No full-time applications.
summary: Analyse behavioural, neural (EEG) and physiological data, and work with the experimental scientists on experiment design and on debugging data collection and pipelines.
requirements: Based in the UK or EU
Ideally, experience with production software systems
apply: Email your CV, a description or demo of one analysis project you led, your hourly or daily rate and your start date to andre@atlasmankind.com, with the subject "Atlas - Data Scientist".

title: Regulatory Affairs Lead
summary: B1Neuro, a National University of Singapore spin-out, builds fMRI-guided TMS for precision brain stimulation. The Regulatory Affairs Lead owns regulatory strategy end to end: submissions for medical technology, compliance, procedures and work with regulators and notified bodies.
apply: Apply by email as described on B1Neuro's careers page: CV (PDF) plus the short answers it asks for, subject "Application: Regulatory Affairs Lead – your name".

title: TMS Technician
summary: Join B1Neuro's clinical team operating TMS equipment and supporting patient care in fMRI-guided brain stimulation.
requirements: Familiarity with TMS equipment is a plus
apply: Apply by email as described on B1Neuro's careers page: CV (PDF) plus the short answers it asks for, subject "Application: TMS Technician – your name".

title: Engineering Intern
summary: Hands-on medical device engineering at AtriCure, including devices for peripheral nerve ablation: testing and validation, test protocols, process development, root-cause analysis and pilot builds.
requirements: Studying for a bachelor's or master's in biomedical, mechanical or a related engineering field

title: Implant Electronics & Systems Engineer
summary: Max Connectivity Neurotech (MCN), an early-stage, venture-backed Houston start-up, is building high-channel-count, long-term implantable neural interfaces around ultraflexible electrodes. This role designs and tests the recording and stimulation electronics, embedded firmware, data acquisition and power systems at the core of the platform, and supports preclinical experiments.
requirements: BS, MS or PhD in electrical, computer or biomedical engineering, physics or a related field
Analog, digital, mixed-signal or embedded electronics
Hands-on work with lab test equipment
A plus: neural recording or stimulation, BCI or other implant experience, ISO 13485 / IEC 60601
apply: Email your resume and a short note about a challenging electronic, embedded or multidisciplinary system you built to job@maxconnectivity.com, with the role title in the subject line.
